meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会陪你一起写博客、深度文章或技术文档：帮你搭大纲、查资料并加引用、改写开头 Hook、逐段给反馈，同时尽量保持你自己的写作风格。
howto.when: 当你开始写博客、教程、案例研究等文章，或要求搭大纲、查资料加引用、改开头 Hook 时进入协作。

say.text: 帮我为「AI 与产品管理」这篇文章搭个大纲
say.note: 它会先问主题、受众、篇幅和写作目标

say.text: 这是我写的开头，帮我把 Hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会分析现有 Hook 并给出多个备选版本

say.text: 研究下 AI 对生产力的影响，把引用加到我的大纲里
say.note: 输出要点、数据与引用条目，加入对应章节

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes alongside you: building outlines, researching with citations, sharpening hooks, and giving section-by-section feedback while keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're drafting blog posts, tutorials, or case studies, or when you ask for an outline, research with citations, or a stronger hook.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about AI and product management
say_en.note: It first asks about topic, audience, length and goal

say_en.text: Here's my intro — help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: It analyzes the current hook and offers alternatives

say_en.text: Research AI's impact on productivity and add citations to my outline
say_en.note: Returns findings, data and references placed in sections
